nodes.name: Daily 18:00
nodes.notes: 18:00 in the workflow timezone (Asia/Bangkok). Evening, so the user answers about today's replies, not yesterday's.

nodes.name: Record Nudge
nodes.notes: Writes a 'nudged' event per job BEFORE the send, so the 7-day clock restarts even if Telegram fails after retries. 'nudged' rows are markers, not statuses: Build Nudges skips them when reading status, and the weekly funnel ignores them.
